text:
Zoe: Idea  mini-office Olympics + tacos afterwards? 5pm quick games (paper airplane toss, chair relay, 10-min puzzle) then grab tacos from the truck by lobby at 6. Low effort, max silliness. Who's down? :taco::medal:
Omar: LOL yes. In. I will absolutely lose at paper airplanes. :airplane:
Li: Love it. Can we keep it <30m so folks still leave on time?
Hana: In if it's quick. I can run the puzzle station.
Priya: Tacos sound great. Any vegan taco options? Also budget?
Zoe: Thinking $10-15 food budget per person. Taco truck has vegan jackfruit tacos.
Omar: I can spot napkins and paper for planes.
Zoe: /poll "Which mini-game do you want most?" "Paper airplane toss" "Minute puzzle" "Chair relay" "Rock-paper-scissors tournament"
events-bot: Poll created: Which mini-game do you want most? Votes open until 3pm.
Li: Also tagging facilities: can we use the courtyard for the games? @facilities
facilities: Courtyard use requested. Tentative approval for 5:00-6:15pm. Please ensure no amplified music.
Hana: I'll bring a stopwatch. Let's keep it family-friendly (no ridiculous dares).
Priya: If tacos sell out, any backup food recs?
Zoe: Backup: pizza from Joe's across the street or pre-order sandwich boxes.
Omar: I vote for paper planes + puzzle. Fast turnover.
Li: Agreed. Short rounds -> more people can join.
Zoe: Perfect. If poll is split we'll run two quick rounds. I'll post a reminder at 4:30 and a tiny schedule: 5:00 intro, 5:05 games start, 5:40 winners & photos, 6:00 tacos.
Priya: I'll bring a small sign for dietary tags (V/GF).
Hana: I'll take photos for the #random channel if everyone's cool with it.
Omar: Cool by me. See you all there! :raised_hands:
